specification: KTP-CORE Section 7.6 (Execution Observation) and KTP-AUDIT Section 3.4 (Decision Outcome)
note: Normative downstream requirements for the execution observation: a decision record attests the decision, the effect is attested only by an observation bound to it. This repository contains no PEP, recorder or execution boundary: these vectors fix the decisions a conformant deployment produces at the boundaries KTP-CORE names and define no formula. given/expect are test notation, not wire fields; an observation shown in `given` is one made at the execution boundary and bound to the decision unless the vector states otherwise.

vectors.reason: A denial with a bound observation of dispatch is a bypass of the enforcement boundary: a conformance failure recorded as such, opening a breach record as KTP-REPAIR specifies.
A consequential decision with no bound observation is unverified as to effect and MUST NOT be reported as an action that did not execute.
The effect is attested by the bound observation: a permitted action observed as non_dispatch is recorded as not executed, and no effect is claimed for it.
